notes.title: (Update 1.0.1) Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

First of all, a huge thank you for your support and feedback during these first few days of launch! ❤️ It's been amazing to see so many players exploring the frozen mountains and sharing their experiences.

We know that each player has a different pace, so, listening to the community's suggestions, we've adjusted some areas of the map to reduce certain stretches of excessive walking, making progression more fluid without taking away from the essence of exploration.

[b]Main changes:[/b]
✅ Reduction of some sections with very long displacements.
✅ Small accessibility adjustments in some objectives.
✅ Minor fixes of reported bugs.
